title: The Dream-Job Elixir
coreMove: Recognize control as a powerful reward that becomes stable only when backed by career capital.
sourcePressure: Control is the next major reward bought by career capital, and it becomes dangerous when pursued without leverage.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Equating control with quitting, remote work, or freedom from obligation.

sourceAnchors.name: The elixir is not escape
sourceAnchors.detail: The locked TOC confirms the chapter as the opening move for Rule 3.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The elixir is not escape; it is the felt change when skill gives you more say over the work.

hook: generic career panic in an inbox
worker staring at a resignation letter
heroic founder myth before any evidence test
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch08: do not open with a generic passion panic
counterintuition: Passion is not X but Y
Most people think meaning comes first
The problem is not motivation, it is discipline
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch08: avoid neat passion versus skill reversal
tryThisNow: set a timer and reflect on your career
write your passion and circle it
ask if your job feels meaningful in general
examples: generic office worker choosing between passion and paycheck
startup founder in a glass conference room
student staring at a blank purpose notebook
kitchen table, mug, laptop, and life crisis
so-good-they-cant-ignore-you-ch08: avoid repeated laptop, mug, kitchen, whiteboard, resignation shells

exampleOpeningDiversity.rule: no more than 2 of the 6 examples may open with the pattern 'At HH:MM, <Name> <verb>s'
exampleOpeningDiversity.requiredOpenings: at least 4 distinct opening devices across the 6 examples, drawn from: timestamp+name+action, dialogue first line, sensory detail first, second-person 'You' direct address, retrospective 'It took her three weeks to see', question-as-hook, environmental detail before any human
exampleOpeningDiversity.rationale: C8 catches Cartesian repetition of phrases but not the deeper template of timestamp + named protagonist + prop + decision that makes 6 examples feel like 1 example with name swaps

rhythmVariety.deepReadParagraphLengthMix: at least one paragraph 3 sentences or shorter, at least one paragraph 5+ sentences, at least one one-sentence punch line
rhythmVariety.fullReadInterludeRequirement: at least one paragraph that breaks the scene-then-rule rhythm: a question to the reader, a research aside, a direct second-person passage, or a brief historical reference
rhythmVariety.forbiddenRhythm: every paragraph following the pattern concrete anchor sentence -> abstract rule sentence -> elaboration sentence
